text: Ben maɓɓe maakani ɓe hino wasiyoo ɓe: wata on naatiroy Misra e damal gootal hiɗon wonndi, ko yo on naatir e dame seertuɗe. Ko ɗum ɓurata hisinnde on diini goɗɗo huuɓitirta on lorra si o immanike on. Mi alaa wowlirannde on ɗum, fii duñangol on lorra mo Alla faandorii on, wanaa kadi fii pooɗangol on nafa mo Alla yiɗanaa on. Ñaawoore alaa si wanaa ñaawoore Alla nden, fiyaaku alaa si wanaa fiyaaku Makko on. Ko e Makko fawii-mi e kala fiyaaku am, ko e Makko Kanko tun, yo fawo fawotooɓe ɓen e fiyakuuji maɓɓe ɗin.
